notes: Hoinka 2015 NAR IL-10RA HT-SELEX data paper (2'-F pyrimidine RNA library). Template structure quoted in M&M: 5'-TCTCGATCTCAGCGAGTCGTCG-N40-CCCATCCCTCTTCCTCTCTCCC-3'. selexprep equivalence handles read-vs-template-orientation via allow_revcomp.

Cibiel 2014 PLOS ONE ("From ugly duckling to swan: anti-Annexin A2 aptamer ACE4"). Selection performed against cells over-expressing ETBR; the ACE4 aptamer was later identified as anti-Annexin A2 (hence the ENA project title). M&M library template: "5'-GGGAGAUGAUCCGUUGAUGCGAG-(N50)-AAGUCGUCGUUCGUAGGCAGAAUC-3'". These primer_*_truth fields are the LIBRARY CONSTANTS (flanking the random region) — NOT the PCR primers P60/P70, which are different sequences (P60 forward = GATTCTGCCTACGAACGACGACTT; P70 reverse = CTCGAGTAATACGACTCACTATAGGGAGATGATCCGTTGATGCGAG with T7 promoter). Library U-letters normalized to T here; selexprep handles U-T via allow_ut.

Pleiko 2019 Scientific Reports differential binding cell-SELEX against ccRCC RCC-MF cells with RC-124 negative control. M&M oligonucleotide library: 5'-ATCCAGAGTGACGCAGCA-N40-TGGACACGGTGGCTTAGT-3'. The paper states sequencing data are available under SRA accession PRJEB28411.
Ozaki 2020 NAR ("RaptRanker"), Data1 = HT-SELEX vs human transglutaminase 2 (TG2). Template per M&M: 5'-TCACACTAGCACGCATAGG-30N-CATCTGACCTCTCTCCTGCTCCC-3'. T7-transcribed RNA library.
Ozaki 2020 NAR ("RaptRanker"), Data2 = HT-SELEX vs human integrin alpha-V beta-3. Template per M&M: 5'-GAGGATCCATGTATGCGCACATA-40N-CTTCTGGTCGAAGTTCTCCC-3'. T7-transcribed RNA library.

Aptamer footprints vs alpha-synuclein fibrillar polymorphs (NAR 2024). Template per M&M: 5'-CCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCT(N35)TCAGCCTCAACGGATACTCTCCC-3'. WARNING: the 5' constant is the revcomp of TruSeq R1 (AGATCGGAAGAGC) — this row will likely trigger selexprep's adapter-trap blacklist (KNOWN_ADAPTERS) and surface as PARTIAL_5P / MISMATCH or safe-failure. Useful edge case for testing adapter-vs-primer disambiguation.

Front Chem 2024 (PMC11324436) — pyoverdine PYO-Pf5 SELEX. Linked via GSE225440 -> BioProject 935703. Library is a split-random-region design: 5'-GCCTGTTGTGAGCCTCCTGTCGAA-(N10)-GGAGCGAATG-(N35)-GAGCGTTTATTCTTGTCTCCC-3'. The outer constants are the inferable primers; total length between them = 10+10+35 = 55 nt. Edge case: selexprep may detect the internal constant GGAGCGAATG as a sub-primer (position consistency would fail because it floats with respect to both ends).

Halder 2023 Scientific Reports SARS-CoV-2 viral oligopeptide/RBD aptamer SELEX. M&M Aptamers and reagents reports library 5'-GGTATTGAGGGTCGCATC-N40-GATGGCTCTAACTCTCCTCT-3'; Data availability lists BioProject PRJNA975735 and SRA runs SRR24718812-SRR24718816.

Hu 2024 Scientific Reports ASFV p30 MB-SELEX. Main text reports PRJNA990511 SRA data, a 40 nt random ssDNA library flanked by two 20 nt primer sequences, and Table S1/S3 sequence details. Supplementary Table S3 reports initial library 5'-ATTGGCACTCCACGCATAGG-(N)40-CCTATGCGTGCTACCGTGAA-3'; Primer B is the reverse-complement primer TTCACGGTAGCACGCATAGG.

Sanford 2021 Chemical Science (PMID 34659704) RE-SELEX for kanamycin A structure-switching aptamers. RSC main text states the N40 library, PCR primers, and BioProject PRJNA728693 data availability. ESI Fig. 2 reports full library 5'-CGCATACCAGCTTAGTTCAGAATTCATT-N40-AGATAGTAAGTGCAATCTCGGC-3'. Edge case: EcoRI site is embedded in the 5' constant as part of the RE-SELEX design.

Ali 2022 Sci Rep "A sputum bioassay for airway eosinophilia using an eosinophil peroxidase aptamer" (EPX). Library DNA_L confirmed visually from MOESM1 supp PDF page 2 Table S1 (text-extraction-resistant raster table; verified by rendering with PyMuPDF/fitz at matrix=3x and visual inspection). Table S1 row contents: DNA_L = ATGCCATCCTACCAAC-N40-GAGCTCTGAACTGG; FP1 (forward primer 1) = ATGCCATCCTACCAAC = 5' library constant; RP1 (reverse primer 1) = CCAGTTCAGAGCTC = revcomp of the 3' library constant GAGCTCTGAACTGG. Reproducible verification: download https://static-content.springer.com/esm/art%3A10.1038%2Fs41598-022-26949-7/MediaObjects/41598_2022_26949_MOESM1_ESM.pdf, then `import fitz; doc=fitz.open(path); doc[1].get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(3,3)).save('p2.png')` and inspect p2.png.
